name: image-clip
purpose: Reveals media inside a static clipping frame using a short transform and opacity transition on the inner layer.

cwvImpact.rationale: The clipping frame has fixed layout while only the contained media layer changes transform and opacity once.

accessibility.reducedMotionFallback: The media is visible in its final clipped frame without transition or animation.

cwvTripwire.layoutShift: The clipping frame remains static while only the inner media layer transitions.
cwvTripwire.longAnimation: The reveal is capped at --dur-3 and has no autonomous or repeating animation.
